name: radpark
description: Software für smarte Fahrradständer (Backend, Ständer-Protokoll, Simulator, später App & Admin)

scripts.stage:admin-grant: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/scripts/grant-admin.ts "$0"'
scripts.stage:admin-revoke: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/scripts/revoke-admin.ts "$0"'
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose restart mosquitto && pnpm db:seed && rm -f apps/simulator/.sim-state.json
scripts.stage:seed: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/db/seed.ts' && docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml restart simulator
scripts.stage:backup: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec backup sh /backup/backup-loop.sh jetzt
scripts.stage:restore: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec backup sh /backup/restore.sh
scripts.stage:station-add: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/scripts/add-station.ts "$0" "$@"'
scripts.stage:mail-test: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml exec api sh -c 'cd apps/api && node_modules/.bin/tsx src/scripts/send-test-mail.ts "$0"'
